sentences.text: This {stage} {sex} flatback turtle was tagged at {release_site} and tracked from {first_date} to {last_date}.
Flatback turtles nest only in Australia and, unlike most sea turtles, stay on the continental shelf rather than crossing oceans.
On {farthest_date} she was {max_displacement_km} from where tracking began, and over {days_tracked} her daily positions add up to {path_km}.
